data.narrative:
ARX Robotics is a Series A-stage defense and security robotics company that has raised €42M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A progression to the €42M raised, implying a valuation of €84M. The peer-median approach references three same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from €125M (NODA AI) to €4.0B (Stark Defence), yielding a median of €400M. This wider range reflects material heterogeneity within the defense robotics space.

The two methods triangulate to a range of €71M (low) to €460M (high), with a median of €242M. The stage-progression method anchors the low end, while the peer-median—driven by Singularity's €400M valuation—informs the midpoint. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the Stark Defence and Singularity comparables given their substantially higher valuations, and whether ARX's technology maturity and customer traction align with the median peer profile. The wide interquartile spread (€71M–€460M) reflects genuine uncertainty in early-stage defense tech valuations.
